generatedCommentsNodes.comment: These two tests (`testPushDownEqualsIgnoreCase` and `testNoPushDownEvalEqualsIgnoreCase`) only assert `assertNotNull(query)` / `assertNull(query)` with a `// TODO: verify query` comment. They provide minimal verification of the actual query structure. Consider either expanding them to assert the expected query JSON (similar to `doTestPushDownChangeCase`) or removing them if the other tests (`testPushDownEqualsToUpper`, `testNoPushDownChangeCase`, etc.) already cover the same scenarios.

review_comment: As an alternative to avoid the pattern matching, use `Strings.deleteAny(input, " ")` or `Strings.replace(input, " ", "")`
The `\s` class will match more (`[ \t\n\x0B\f\r]`). I use it to compare (multiline, "randomly" spaced) JSONs.
